# `Q-24-7` — List Number Styles Lost

> Some numbered lists used letters, roman numerals or parenthesised numbers, which Quarto Markdown can't write. They were imported as ordinary numbered lists.

## What this means

Quarto Markdown has no marker for lettered (`a.`), roman (`i.`) or parenthesised (`(1)`) lists. The list keeps its start number and its items; the style is lost.

## Why this happens

- The document has lists numbered `a)`, `A.`, `i.`, `(1)` or similar.

## How to fix

Edit the imported list to use plain numbers, or accept the numbering. Changing Quarto Markdown's grammar to keep list styles is not planned.
